statusDefinitions.LICENSING_UNCLEAR: Actual source exists but commercial transformation/hosting grant unresolved or contradictory.
statusDefinitions.UNSUITABLE: Acquired or documented source fails geographic, quality or purpose gates.
statusDefinitions.UNAVAILABLE: No suitable exact published deliverable located after alternate routes, not global proof of absence.
